name: 火云
english_description: The in-game title is Fire Cloud Chronicle 2000 (火云录2000), an ES2/Jin-Yong-themed wuxia MUD. Despite sharing the "hy" slug prefix with hy/hy2000/hy2002 (this project's "Ocean" family), a file-by-file comparison of master.lpc/securd.lpc/securityd.lpc confirms it's an unrelated codebase — an entirely different 363-line master.lpc (credited to "change by xhh") versus the three byte-identical 332-line "for ES II mudlib" copies shared by the Ocean family, and its own wizard lineage under u/ (xingyun, xingyu, hsly). Real content beyond the standard Jin Yong sect map (Huashan, Shaolin, Emei, Kunlun, Quanzhen, the Beggars' Sect, Tianlong Temple, Lingjiu Palace, Peach Blossom Island, plus Mongol/Dali regions): an assassins'-guild faction ("Killer Tower," d/shashou/), a marriage system (d/marry/), and a genuine anti-theft design where an admin logging in from an unlisted IP is challenged with a live random math problem before being let in. A full death-to-Ghost-Gate-to-revival cycle works end to end.
